context: Implemented worktree-aware .twining root resolution (server 2.3.0-pending + plugin 1.20.0): resolveWorktreeMain in src/utils/project-root.ts redirects the cwd-default root to the main checkout when .git is a gitdir: worktree pointer (submodules excluded, TWINING_WORKTREE_LOCAL=true opt-out, --project/TWINING_PROJECT never redirected); byte-identical mirrored block in all five plugin hooks, which now also honor TWINING_PROJECT; pre-commit hook gained walk-up detection and its hard-coded sentinel path was fixed to $TWINING_DIR. E2E verified in a real clone+worktree: teammate server now writes the MAIN store (inverse of the pre-fix observation), opt-out and hook sentinel reads confirmed. 1286 tests passing, 33 new. Fixes the cmux claude-teams --worktree store-divergence finding 01KY66434W.
rationale: falling back would gate against a store the user explicitly redirected away from, causing the exact false-block bug this work fixes (subagent decision, ratified).
summary: Chose hook fail-open (no walk-up fallback) when TWINING_PROJECT points at a store that doesn't exist
